title.narrative: Inclusive Emergency Response for Older Men and Women, Older People headed households; Older People with Disabilities El Nina and consequent flood in Tete Province.

description.narrative: Name of the Objective/activities Total targeted Population Procurement & distribution of food items 1,000 Procurement and distribution of seeds 1,000 Distribution of cholera preventive kits 1000

Objective-1. Secure food and improved nutrition for 210 households headed by 400 Older people and people with disability affected by the floods in Tete province, through provision of food items.
(activity-1) 1.1- -Procurement & distribution of food items to 210 Households (1,050 individuals (of which 400 Older People), 60% Female & at least 15% persons with disabilities) # 400 Older people in 210HHs have received food items kits. 481Older people in 210HHs have received food items kits. The variation is due to the fact that the beneficiary registration data show us that many elderly people live alone or with their grandchildren. And on top of this, they shared the produts with other people in the comunity Distribution register, Monitoring reports, Bank transfer slip, and Photographs.. activity-2) (add row as per the requirement) 1.2- Procurement and distribution of seeds to 210 Households (1050 individuals (of which 400 Older People), 60% Female& at least 15% persons with disabilities) # 400 Older people in 210HHs have received seeds kits. 481 Older people in 210HHs have received food items kits. The justification it’s the same as done above Distribution register, Monitoring reports, Bank transfer slip, and Photographs.

Objective-2 Increase the access of older people to cholera prevention and awareness, through messaging and face to face sensitization, reaching 11,000 people. (activity-2.1) 2.1- Produce accessible IEC materials and share key messages on cholera prevention through community volunteers, community radio broadcasts and theatre (drama). # 1,050 Direct Beneficiaries - number of people reached through cholera prevention messages. # 11,000 Indirect beneficiaries number of people in the community and beyond reached through community radio broadcast and theatre (drama). # 2,730 Direct Beneficiaries - number of people reached through cholera prevention messages. # 11,000 Indirect beneficiaries number of people in the community and beyond reached through community radio broadcast and theatre (drama). The variation is due to the fact that many elderly people live with a larger household (on average 13) and within an extended family with whom they shared the goods they received. Monitoring Report, Photographs, receipts.
(activity-2.2) Distribution of cholera preventive kits (water purification package) to 210 households headed by older people. # 400 Older people in 210HHs receive gender sensitive hygiene kits. # 150 People with Disabilities receive water purification kits (kits will include water tablets and soaps). # 481 Older people in 210HHs receive gender sensitive hygiene kits. # 34 People with Disabilities receive water purification kits (kits will include water tablets and soaps). The variation is due to the fact that many elderly people live alone. In the sense that few live with their partners. As we mentioned above, the elderly live in an extended family with their grandchildren and children. But there are few cases in which both live together. Monitoring Report, Photographs, receipts.
